entries.544af0775b8d63b5: Its management philosophy is "customer satisfaction and employee satisfaction." Under its medium-term management plan "NEXT STEP 10" (from the fiscal year ended October 2023 to the fiscal year ended October 2027), it advanced selection and concentration of businesses and withdrew from the real estate business and unprofitable departments. In the timber business, it focuses on developing new markets and new customers, switching to domestic timber, and improving production efficiency, and in the House Eco business, it works on winning orders related to school facilities from government agencies and strengthening design, manufacturing and sales capabilities.
entries.56f7dc36a91a5915: Revenue for the fiscal year ended October 2025 was ¥12,639 million, increasing from the previous fiscal year, and revenue in the House Eco business grew substantially to 134.0% of the previous fiscal year.
